package query

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestCaptureCandidateCorruptEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	var cases []struct{ Name, Query string }
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/candidate-index/corrupt-cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	all := []any{}
	for _, fixture := range []string{"clean", "bad-first-unmatched", "bad-last-unmatched", "bad-matched"} {
		g := candidateGraph(t, fixture)
		for _, c := range cases {
			for _, cross := range []bool{false, true} {
				run := func(ctx context.Context) map[string]any {
					item := map[string]any{"name": c.Name, "query": c.Query, "cross": cross, "fixture": fixture}
					var result Result
					var err error
					if cross {
						result, err = ExecuteCross(ctx, []Graph{{"a", g}, {"b", g}}, c.Query, nil, -1)
					} else {
						result, err = Execute(ctx, g, c.Query, nil, -1)
					}
					if err != nil {
						var e *Error
						if errors.As(err, &e) {
							item["error"], item["message"] = e.Class, e.Message
						} else {
							item["error"], item["message"] = "GoError", err.Error()
						}
					} else {
						item["columns"], item["rows"] = result.Columns, result.Rows
					}
					return item
				}
				indexed := run(context.Background())
				scan := run(context.WithValue(context.Background(), candidateScanOnlyKey{}, true))
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(indexed, scan) {
					t.Fatalf("%s/%s indexed and scan differ", fixture, c.Name)
				}
				all = append(all, indexed)
			}
		}
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(all, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile("testdata/candidate-index/corrupt-native.json", append(data, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
